summary: Beam Global filed an 8-K on November 5, 2026, disclosing mutual termination of its October 6, 2026 Share Sale and Purchase Agreement to acquire all outstanding shares of Norwegian private company ScoutDI AS from its shareholders, with Husteli AS as sellers' representative. The long-stop date of November 4, 2026 passed without closing; citing unfavorable U.S. public-market conditions, both parties declined to extend and delivered written termination notices effective immediately. No cash consideration is payable and no Beam shares will be issued; the agreement carries no termination fee, with each side bearing its own costs. The parties will explore alternative commercial arrangements. Watch for any replacement manufacturing or distribution deal.
